ApiError.description: Error body. Clients choose the text they show by `code`; `message` is a default text for a `code` they do not know.

code.description: Stable error key. See docs/integrate/conventions.md for the list.

fields.description: Present only when the error is about specific fields (400 `INVALID_INPUT`).

commentId.description: The comment it belongs to; null for a file on the issue itself.

fileName.description: Cleared to null when the attachment is deleted (COM-7, ATT-5).

id.description: Hard to guess, but not a permission check (ATT-7).

accountId.description: 0 for popdesk itself (the first admin, commands in the container).

action.description: The kind of action as the entry holds it now; it may be a changed value.
The kind of action: a value of the `action` filter. An entry someone changed in the database may hold another name, so this is a plain string.

changes.description: What changed, as stored. A changed value is `{"from": ..., "to": ...}` under its field name; a value set for the first time is the value itself. Null when the action changes no value.

hash.description: SHA-256 of `prevHash` and the entry's canonical JSON: 64 lowercase hex characters.

occurredAt.description: When the action was done, with microseconds.

prevHash.description: The `hash` of the entry before this one in the chain; 64 zeros for the first.

seq.description: The entry's place in the hash chain, from 1.

target.description: What the action was done to, as stored: `type` (`ACCOUNT`, `COMPANY`, `DATABASE`, `AUDIT_LOG`) and the keys that name it (`accountId`, `code`).

brokenEntry.description: The first entry that does not hold. Null when `valid`, and for `HEAD_MISMATCH`, where no entry that is left is wrong.

checkedCount.description: Entries whose hash was computed again and matched.

valid.description: Every entry and the end of the chain hold.

newPassword.description: 10 to 72 characters, not only whitespace, not the same as the email (AUTH-5).

internal.description: Internal comments do not exist for customers (CMT-2).

code.description: 2 to 10 capital letters and digits. Unique, never changes.

internal.description: An internal comment, hidden from customers. Public when left out.

code.description: 2 to 10 capital letters and digits, unique. Cannot be changed later.

companyCodes.description: Codes of the companies a customer joins. At least one for `CUSTOMER`; left out or empty for staff.

auditEntryId.description: The audit entry of an outside copy (`AUDIT_FORWARD`); null for the other channels.

lastErrorKind.description: Kind of the last error, for example `CONNECTION_REFUSED`; never the error text.

recipientAccountId.description: The receiving account of an email; null for a webhook.

code.description: Stable field error key, for example `TOO_LONG`.

field.description: Name of the request field or query parameter.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such account.

Without SMTP the response carries the link instead, once (S1A-AC-37). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such account.

400.description: `OWN_ACCOUNT`: the caller's own account (S1A-AC-33). `LAST_ADMIN`: no `ACTIVE` admin would be left (S1A-AC-81). `ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE`: the account never accepted its invitation (`INVITED`, or a cancelled invitation); cancel the invitation instead.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such account.

get.description: Newest first; entries of the same time by `seq`, highest first (S1B-AC-01). The filters narrow it together (S1B-AC-03 to S1B-AC-06). No entry holds a password, a token, or a link (S1B-AC-07).

get.description: Every entry the filters of `listAuditEntries` find, in chain order (`seq`, lowest first), streamed as a file (S1B-AC-23, S1B-AC-27). `JSONL` has one JSON object per line with `id`, `seq`, `prevHash`, `hash`, `action`, `actor`, `target`, `changes`, `occurredAt`: everything needed to compute each hash again (S1B-AC-24). `CSV` has the same columns, `actor` as three columns and `target` and `changes` as JSON text; a value that starts with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab, or a line break gets `'` in front (S1B-AC-25). The export itself is recorded as `AUDIT_EXPORTED` when it starts and is not in its own file (S1B-AC-26): its target is `{"type": "AUDIT_LOG"}` and its changes are `format`, `count` (entries found when it started), and `filter` (an object with only the filters that were sent; `{}` without any). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store`.

post.description: Computes every hash again from the start of the chain, or from the kept starting point when old entries were removed by the retention period (S1B-AC-14, S1B-AC-17). A broken chain is a 200 with `valid` false: `ENTRY_MISMATCH` names the first entry that does not hold (a changed entry, or the entry after a removed one), `HEAD_MISMATCH` means the last entries were removed (S1B-AC-15, S1B-AC-16, S1B-AC-42). A valid result does not rule out that the whole chain was written again. One check runs at a time.
post.summary: Check the audit log's hash chain

get.description: All companies for admins, assigned ones for agents (S0-AC-32), in code order.

`INVALID_INPUT`: `name` or `legalName` empty or over 100, `code` not 2 to 10 capital letters and digits (`INVALID_FORMAT`).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such company or account.

delete.summary: Take an agent off a company

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `page` or `size` out of range (`OUT_OF_RANGE`).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such company, or the caller cannot see it.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such company or account.

delete.summary: Take a customer out of a company

put.description: The customer, invited ones included, sees the company and its public issues from the next request. Adding again is 200 too (S1A-AC-50).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: the account is not a customer (field `accountId` `UNKNOWN_VALUE`) (S1A-AC-51). `COMPANY_NOT_ACTIVE`: the company is `ARCHIVED` (S1A-AC-48).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such company or account.

put.summary: Make a customer a member of a company

put.description: `ACTIVE` to `SUSPENDED` and back, or either to `ARCHIVED` (S1A-AC-44). The status the company already has is 200 too, for `ACTIVE` and `SUSPENDED`. Nothing new can be filed in a company that is not `ACTIVE`; what is there stays readable (S1A-AC-46, S1A-AC-47).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `status` missing (`REQUIRED`) or unknown (`UNKNOWN_VALUE`). `COMPANY_ARCHIVED`: the company is `ARCHIVED`, which is final (S1A-AC-45).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such company, or the caller cannot see it.

get.description: `INVITED` accounts, newest invitation first (S0-AC-40), and cancelled invitations, marked `cancelled` (S1A-AC-42).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `page` or `size` out of range (`OUT_OF_RANGE`).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `email` malformed or over 100, `name` empty or over 50, `role` unknown, `companyCodes` empty for a customer (`REQUIRED`), given for staff (`NOT_ALLOWED`), or naming a company that does not exist or is not `ACTIVE` (`UNKNOWN_VALUE`) (S0-AC-34).

post.description: Makes the account `SUSPENDED` and its link stop working; an invitation email still queued is not sent (S1A-AC-39). The account stays in the list as `cancelled`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such account.

post.description: Only without SMTP. Makes a new token, so the previous link stops working, and returns the link once (S0-AC-38). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S0-AC-101).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: SMTP is configured (S0-AC-39), or no `INVITED` account has this ID.

post.summary: Make a new invitation link to copy

A cancelled invitation becomes `INVITED` again (S1A-AC-40). Without SMTP the response carries the link instead, once. The response has `Cache-Control: no-store`.

400.description: `INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED`: the account accepted its invitation before (S1A-AC-41).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such account.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

put.description: Ends every other session of the account and gives this one a new session ID (S1A-AC-02, S1A-AC-17).

204.description: The account has no photo now.

400.description: `UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE`: not one of the three formats, or it cannot be decoded (S1A-AC-22). `IMAGE_TOO_LARGE`: width times height is over 25 million pixels for PNG and JPEG, 12 million for WebP (S1A-AC-23). `INVALID_INPUT`: no `file` part (`REQUIRED`).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such item in the caller's inbox.

Always PNG, with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cache-Control: private, no-cache`, and an `ETag` (S1A-AC-87): the browser asks again every time, so the caller's right to see the photo is checked again, and gets 304 while the photo is the same.

parameters.description: The `ETag` of the copy the caller has.
parameters.name: If-None-Match

get.description: For mail, webhook, and the outside copy of the audit log (`auditForward`): configured or not, last success, queued and failed rows (S0-AC-81, S1B-AC-33). The console also reads `mail.enabled` to decide whether to offer invitation links (C-10).
Sets the readable CSRF cookie before the first request that changes data (sign-in, accepting an invitation). Clients send its value back in a request header.

post.description: Sets the password, makes the account `ACTIVE`, and signs it in to its app (S0-AC-36). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S0-AC-101).

204.description: Accepted and signed in. The session cookie is set.

400.description: `INVITATION_INVALID`: the token is unknown, expired, used, or replaced by a newer one, or the token is sent to the other app's host (a customer's token on the console host, a staff token on the portal host); one body for all (S0-AC-37). `INVALID_INPUT`: the password breaks AUTH-5 (field `password`: `TOO_SHORT`, `TOO_LONG`, `BLANK`, `SAME_AS_EMAIL`).

post.description: Sets the password, lifts a sign-in lock, and ends every session of the account. It does not sign in (S1A-AC-09, S1A-AC-04). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S1A-AC-14).

400.description: `PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID`: the token is unknown, over 1 hour old, used, or replaced by a newer one, the account is no longer `ACTIVE`, or the token is sent to the other app's host; one body for all (S1A-AC-10, S1A-AC-84). `INVALID_INPUT`: the password breaks AUTH-5 (field `password`: `TOO_SHORT`, `TOO_LONG`, `BLANK`, `SAME_AS_EMAIL`); the token stays usable (S1A-AC-11).

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link

post.description: Queues an email with a reset link for an `ACTIVE` account of the app of the host the request came to (S1A-AC-06). The link works for 1 hour and replaces an earlier one; a second request within 15 minutes sends nothing (S1A-AC-12). The answer is the same whether or not an email is sent (S1A-AC-05).

202.description: Taken. The same empty answer whether the email is unknown, the account is invited or suspended, or it belongs to the other app.

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `email` is empty (`REQUIRED`).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 20 requests from one IP address in 60 seconds. `Retry-After` says when to try again (S1A-AC-13).

post.summary: Ask for a password reset email

post.description: Signs in to the app of the host the request came to: customers on the portal host, agents and admins on the console host. Creates a new session (S0-AC-17, S0-AC-21).

204.description: Signed in. The session cookie is set.

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: email or password is empty.

401.description: `SIGN_IN_FAILED`: the same body whether the email is unknown, the password is wrong, the account is invited, suspended, or locked, or it belongs to the other app (S0-AC-22, S0-AC-23).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 20 attempts from one IP address in 60 seconds. `Retry-After` says when to try again (S0-AC-24).

post.description: Deletes the caller's session (S0-AC-27). Succeeds also without a session.
